status.outdated: A new version is out: reload the page
menu.tagline: Conquer a world with no edges.
menu.name: Your name
hud.spawnPick: Click on land to choose where you start. {seconds} s left.
hud.spawnMove: Click elsewhere to move your start. Attacks open in {seconds} s.
hud.playHint: Click land next to yours to expand, or a neighbour to attack.
hud.eliminated: You have been eliminated. You can keep watching.
help.title: Controls
help.click: Click or tap: expand or attack
help.keys: Arrows or WASD: move · + and −: zoom
help.ratio: 1 to 9: attack with 10 % to 90 % of your troops, 0: all of them
help.pause: P: pause · H: this help · Esc: close
webgl.missing: Frontfall needs WebGL 2 to draw the map, and this browser could not provide it. Try updating your browser, or turning on hardware acceleration in its settings.
game.failed: The game could not start. Try again, or pick another map.
beta.label: Beta
beta.notice: Beta: rules, balance and visuals will change until 1.0.
hud.leaveConfirm: Leave this game and go back to the menu?
hud.goal: Win: {share} of the land, be the last one standing, or hold the most land when time runs out
click.troops: Not enough troops: raise the attack ratio or wait.
click.unreachable: Out of reach: no shared border, and no ship can land there.
click.ships: All your ships are at sea: wait for one to land.
help.ships: Click a coast across the sea to send a ship
hud.retreatHint: Call the troops back; {penalty} of them are lost
online.title: Online game
online.heading: Play online
online.noGames: No public game is waiting: join one and others will follow.
online.waitingHost: {players}/{capacity} players. The host starts the game when everyone is in.
online.ended.abandoned: The game ended: every player left.
online.ended.timeout: The game ended: it ran past its time limit.
online.ended.expired: The game expired: it did not start within ten minutes.
online.error.not_found: No game has this invitation link. It may have ended.
online.error.too_many_games: The server is full. Try again in a few minutes.
online.error.invalid_name: The server refused this name. Choose another one in the menu.
online.desync: Your game no longer matches the other players'. Reload the page to rejoin.
online.rejected: The server closed the connection. Reload the page to try again.
online.unknownMap: This game is played on a map this page does not have. Reload the page to get the latest version.
online.error.already_in_game: You are already in a game. Leave it first.
online.error.not_in_game: You are not in a game any more.
online.error.not_host: Only the host can do this.
online.error.token_invalid: This game has ended, or went on without you.
hud.cityHint: City (C): raises your troop cap. Then click your land.
hud.fortHint: Fort (F): nearby land costs twice as much to take. Then click your land.
hud.demolishHint: Demolish (X): remove one of your structures, with no refund.
hud.modeCity: Click your land to build a city. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeFort: Click your land to build a fort. Esc to cancel.
hud.modeDemolish: Click one of your structures to demolish it. Esc to cancel.
click.land: Your land supports no more cities: take more land first.
help.build: C: city · F: fort · X: demolish, then click your land
diplo.betrayConfirm: Confirm: betray and lower your defence
diplo.eventEnded: The alliance of {a} and {b} has ended
click.ally: This land is an ally's: betray them first to attack.
help.diplomacy: Right click, long press or a leaderboard row: diplomacy
